gloss: breakthrough power; ability to break through

definitions.gloss: breakthrough power; ability to break through obstacles
definitions.explanation: The force, ability, or drive needed to overcome barriers, whether physical, strategic, or figurative.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦フォワード→フォワード：06586_fowaado⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{突破力|とっぱりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: That forward has great breakthrough ability.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現状|げんじょう}→現状：02721_genjou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{突破力|とっぱりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: You need breakthrough power to change the status quo.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{突破力|とっぱりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{局面|きょくめん}→局面：05777_kyokumen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打開|だかい}→打開：09347_dakai⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧がいない。
examples.english: This team has no player who can break open the game with individual breakthrough ability.

notes:
Combines ⟦{突破|とっぱ}→突破：13755_toppa⟧ (breakthrough) with {力|りょく} (power; ability). Used both literally in sports and military contexts, and figuratively in business and personal development contexts to describe the ability to overcome difficult situations or barriers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {突破力|とっぱりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have breakthrough ability
- ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{突破力|とっぱりょく}: individual breakthrough ability
- {突破力|とっぱりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: to lack breakthrough ability
- {突破力|とっぱりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧: to demonstrate breakthrough ability

USAGE:
Particularly common in sports commentary (especially soccer, rugby, and basketball) to describe a player's ability to dribble past defenders. Also used in business to describe leaders or teams that can push through organizational resistance or market barriers.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{推進力|すいしんりょく}→推進力：15905_suishinryoku⟧: driving force — emphasizes sustained forward momentum rather than breaking through specific barriers
- {打開力|だかいりょく}: ability to break through a deadlock — focuses specifically on resolving stalemate situations
- ⟦{突破|とっぱ}→突破：13755_toppa⟧: breakthrough — the base noun without the emphasis on ability or capacity
